name: Nextgreen Global Berhad
summary: Nextgreen Global Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in printing and publishing business in Malaysia, China, France, Singapore, and the United States. It operates through five segments: Investment holding, Printing and Publishing, Manufacturing, Property and Construction, and Utility and Renewable Energy segments. The company involved in processing, manufacturing, importing, exporting, and trading of pulp and paper products, animal feeds, fertilizers, and related products from waste products; undertakes construction and renovation works; produces and supplies biomass power and energy; and constructs, develops, and manages industrial parks.
